description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Elemental MediaPackage VOD service. It declares methods for various API operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, and utilizes namespaces and class inheritance.

classes.name: MediaPackageVodClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS MediaPackage VOD service, providing methods to manage media assets, packaging configurations, and groups.

methods.name: configureLogs
methods.description: Method to configure logging for the MediaPackage VOD service.

methods.name: createAssetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to create a new media asset.

methods.name: createPackagingConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to create a packaging configuration.

methods.name: createPackagingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to create a packaging group.

methods.name: deleteAssetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to delete an asset.

methods.name: deletePackagingConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to delete a packaging configuration.

methods.name: deletePackagingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to delete a packaging group.

methods.name: describeAsset
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific asset.

methods.name: describeAssetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to describe an asset.

methods.name: describePackagingConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to describe a packaging configuration.

methods.name: describePackagingGroup
methods.description: Retrieves details of a packaging group.

methods.name: describePackagingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to describe a packaging group.

methods.name: listPackagingConfigurationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to list packaging configurations.

methods.name: listPackagingGroupsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to list packaging groups.

methods.name: updatePackagingGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous variant to update a packaging group.
